content:
We are very happy to announce the release of Waterproof for Lean.

Waterproof is an educational proof assistant which allows teachers to create exercises sheets with informal explanations, inline LaTeX and formal proofs. We support Verbose Lean (by @Patrick Massot) and Yalep (by @Frédéric Tran Minh and collaborators), in addition to regular Lean.

If you want to try out Waterproof, follow the steps below for the Verbose Lean variant, assuming you already have Lean installed:

  1. Create a new profile in VS Code (Needed because we conflict with the Lean Extension)
  2. Install the Waterproof extension in VS Code in this new profile
  3. Clone https://github.com/impermeable/introduction-to-proof-sheets-lean
  4. Run lake exe cache get and lake build in the introduction-to-proof-sheets-lean folder
  5. Open the introduction-to-proofs-sheets-lean in VS Code.
  6. View any of the exercise sheets in the Bewijzen/Lecture* folders.

If you want to get a general impression without installing, you can visit the aquarium, backed by the Rocq version of Waterproof.

We are very happy to hear any feedback (and discussion) in this thread. (Or, if you are at FLoC/ITP, let me know and we can discuss over coffee:))
